description: Make official Modal Carbon 8 firmware boot on an Argon 8 (model id 0x18) unit.

provenance.source_images: Official Modal Electronics firmware files, supplied by the user. Not included in this repository and not obtainable through it.
provenance.verified_on: NOT YET VERIFIED ON HARDWARE. Built from static analysis of the Carbon 8 1-1 and Argon 8 3-2 images.
provenance.confirmed: Pending: an Argon 8 unit booting this set has not been observed yet.

edits.what: cmp r3,#0x1d -> cmp r3,#0xff (model gate operand low 7 bits). VMA 0x437EDA
cmp r3,#0x1d -> cmp r3,#0xff (set bit 0 in MSB bundle byte so operand is 0xff, not 0x7f)

notes: The gate immediate is 0xff, not 0x18: the panel reads the unit's model from byte 12 of a 128-byte block fetched through the flash controller (0x400E0A00), and the stock Argon 3-2 panel only accepts 0xff there (cmp r3,#0xff at VMA 0x438F3C). Argon units therefore report 0xff; 0x18 is only the model byte in the SysEx packet header.

The Argon bootloader's native framing is the legacy 165-byte data packet with an 8-bit checksum (as in the official Argon 3-2 files), so the patcher reframes Carbon's 167-byte packets to 165 bytes. Payloads are unchanged.
Only the packet model byte (and framing) changes on master/slave; their payloads are untouched (no model check found in either image).
Every Carbon 1-1 image is smaller than its Argon 3-2 counterpart (panel 0x3CD80 vs 0x46E00, master 0x74E00 vs 0x76F80, slave 0x5E980 vs 0x89B00 bytes).
Carbon 8 firmware revision 1-1 only; other revisions have a different layout and are deliberately refused by the SHA-256 gate.
